location: CH-BE, Bachmann-Geiser cat. no. 204; inv. no. 1558c, 5548e, 24911c; ex Gemeinde**** Muri bei Bern; acquired by the museum 1905.
remarks: Two fragments of two different trombones: (1) inner slide tubes from a tenor trombone, joined by undecorated slide stay, all made of copper; (2) single inner slide tube from a trombone, perhaps an alto, made of copper.
